title: EasyCommandLinker
description: Are you searching for a Simple Plugin that lets you Link a Command to an Item by just typing a Command. Congrats, you Search has come to and End. With this super simple  Plugin, you can Link ANY Server Command to ANY Item
body:
Are you searching for a Simple Plugin that lets you Link a Command to an Item ? Well I, ADuckPlayingMC presents you the SIMPLEST Plugin that lets you Link ANY Server Command to ANY Item. After searching for Hours and not finding anything, i decided to code this Plugin myself. I am proud of the Plugin because it is just soooo Simple to Install and Use !

Commands:/linkitemcmd <command>

Check the Galerie for for Informations !

**Important: You need to RENAME an Item first befor linking a Command**
